_comment: The canonical inventory/equipment loop, for the classless start + gift relocation + ambush. Route: inn_chest pickup (leather_jerkin, items:2) -> floodplains -> meet Relc -> SPAR (accept no longer grants the spear) -> win the trivial spar -> re-talk Relc for the GIFT node ('You said you had something for me?' -> relcs_spare_spear + given_spear_by_relc) -> return to the inn, sleep -> Warrior L1 (the kit the equip test needs) -> equip the spear via the real UI (items:3, gift at index 2) -> cross the floodplains proximity ambush (goblin_encounter_1) with the warrior+spear kit + Relc ally -> THE kit proof: combat.combatants.pc.skills == [basic_swordwork, tough_body, piercing_strikes] (power_strike weapon:sword gated OUT, piercing_strikes weapon:spear kept IN) -> victory -> journal still lists BOTH warrior skills (knowledge != fieldability). Seed 9 (live play). The autoplay tally limitation and loot-roll determination are unchanged (see the comments at those steps).

steps._comment: inn_chest at [1,8]; jog left one column early to its own approach: (2,3)->down3->(2,6)->left1->(1,6)->down1->(1,7), then face down (blocked by the chest) and interact. (#49: the ground-floor alcove bed that used to sit at [2,7] is removed -- this route never passed through that cell anyway, unaffected.)

Qualified wait (repo pattern for this toast-race class): clears the Got toast off the since-marker. The one-time first-pickup 'Press I -- your pack.' hint queues right behind it but is harmless -- every later toast wait in this script is qualified or a different event type, so nothing unqualified can match the hint.

I opens the panel -- carried count pinned to 2 (rusty_sword starter + leather_jerkin). ui_inventory_shown carries item_effect_lines (one generated line-array per carried item, WIEffectText source, parallel to the rendered cards) -- rusty_sword's mods are all 0 so its card shows NO effect lines ([]); the leather_jerkin card shows its generated hp + gold-value lines. This pins the exact strings the inventory detail card draws.
steps.name: inventory

steps._comment: Back to spawn (2,3), then inn_door: (1,7)->up1->(1,6)->right1->(2,6)->up3->(2,3), right13 lands ON the door (15,3).
== meet Relc, spar ==. (7,6) right5->(12,6), down6->(12,12), interact.
SOCIAL PILLAR II PHASE C: first talk to Relc this waking now absorbs the rotating pool line (dialogue_line + chatted_with_<id> + heard_gossip banks); a second interact opens the real conversation.
Meet option 0 'Just a traveler...' banks met_relc -> banter.
steps.name: confirm

steps._comment: Banter option 0 'spear? (Spar)' -> spar_offer.
steps.name: confirm

payload_contains.speaker: Relc
payload_contains.text: Ha! Good instinct. Everyone swings wrong until someone laughs at them. Watch keeps training dummies in the gatehouse; I drag a couple out when gate duty gets slow. Don't ask about the wheels. Rules are simple: you move, you hit, you don't cry.

steps._comment: spar_offer option 0 'Ready when you are.' -> start_combat relc_spar (NO item -- the gift moved off the accept).
steps.name: confirm

steps._comment: The spar accept grants no NEW item (the spear moved to the gift node); proving that here is redundant with the chest's item_gained already in the log, so tutorial_flow owns the accept-grants-nothing assertion instead.
== GIFT node ==. Re-talk Relc; meet (met+sparred, given_spear unset) options ['What's out'(0), 'You said you had something'(1), 'Spar'(2), 'Keep walking'(3)] -- index 1 is the spear.
steps.name: interact

steps._comment: == return to inn, sleep -> Warrior L1 (needed for the kit proof) ==. (12,12) up6->(12,6), left5->(7,6), up+interact -> inn (14,3), left12->(2,3), down3->(2,6), down blocks on the bed, interact -> sleep.
#49: ground-floor alcove bed removed; teleport up to your_bed (the inn's only bed now) since the inn walk isn't this beat's subject.
== equip the spear ==. Inventory is now [rusty_sword, leather_jerkin, relcs_spare_spear] (gift appended last, index 2); cursor resets to 0 on open -> two move_down presses select the spear.
steps.name: inventory

steps._comment: item_effect_lines parallel to [rusty_sword, leather_jerkin, relcs_spare_spear] -- the gift spear's generated +1 damage line now shows on its card.

== cross the floodplains ambush (goblin_encounter_1) with the warrior+spear kit ==. Teleport down to (2,3) (the cell the old ground-floor route reached via 'up 3'); resumes unchanged: right12->(14,3), right1->(15,3) inn_door -> floodplains (7,6), right23->(30,6), down14->(30,20), down1 springs the ambush.

THE kit proof: warrior L1 kit is basic_swordwork+tough_body+power_strike+piercing_strikes; with the spear equipped, power_strike (weapon:sword) is gated OUT and piercing_strikes (weapon:spear) stays IN -- exact-array match.
Count is 4 (attack+dash+piercing_strikes+end) -- identical to the sword baseline, so the count alone doesn't distinguish kits; the array above is the real proof.

Loot: goblin_encounter_1's loot is [{crude_blade,0.25},{gold:2,0.5}], rolled off the ISOLATED run-seed(=CLI --seed=9)+encounter-id RNG (never the live stream, so the pinned combat seed is untouched). At seed 9 the item does NOT drop (crude_blade r=0.312 > 0.25) but the appended gold entry FIRES (r=0.341 < 0.5): loot_dropped now carries {gold:2} (no items key) and an 'Earned 2 gold.' toast follows. Assert the coin drop positively. Re-derive via qa/loot_probe.gd if items.json/loot changes.

AUTOPLAY tally limitation (unchanged): the melee AI only ever calls power_strike by literal name, so with a spear it never use_skill's piercing_strikes -> spear_skill_used never accrues; and the sword was never equipped in a non-trivial fight -> sword_skill_used never accrues. Both absent is the true, code-confirmed outcome.

Knowledge != fieldability: even with the spear equipped (power_strike gated out of the live kit), the journal still lists BOTH warrior grants -- skills_journal is never weapon-filtered. skill_count 5 (1 innate + 4 warrior).
steps.name: journal

steps._comment: Audio-coverage assertions. This loop already traverses every juice beat -- chest pickup (item_gained), spar+ambush hits (attack_resolved{hit}) & won ambush (combat_finished{victory}), the Warrior sleep (class_gained = THE ding), the spear equip (item_equipped), and door transitions (map_changed) -- so it doubles as the audio_played coverage-map proof (chosen over a bespoke audio_feedback script: same coverage, no new seed to derive, assert-only so the pinned seed-9 run is untouched). Every assert is payload-qualified by id, keeping the FIFO/qualified-wait discipline. audio_played fires in headless as 'mapping validated + would have played' (WIAudio silent no-op, no device), which is exactly the coverage surface.
